texts.en:
The time has come to colonize another world. First we will have to [GetBuildGrow] a £colony_ship£ Colony Ship. These Ships take a long time to [GetBuildGrow] and require a large amount of £alloys£ Alloys, £food£ Food, and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods, but a thriving £colony£ Colony will more than return on this investment.

Click on your Starbase and open the Shipyard tab. Then select Colony Ship from the available designs.

You'll need enough resources before construction can begin.
